title: Spanish Gold 18.75-Inch Oval Combination Shower Basket - Wall Mount Solid Brass Caddy With Concealed Screws, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop juggling bottles on the tub ledge and keep shower essentials neatly in reach—backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Available in Spanish Gold. Spanish Gold presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired. This wall-mounted, oval combination shower basket is crafted from solid brass with ventilated, heavy-gauge wires that will never rust.

  • Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Promote drainage with ventilated wire construction for a tidier shower area
  • Maintain a clean look with a concealed screw mounting system
  • Choose a designer finish that complements traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories

Unlike mass-market alternatives, solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives for everyday bathroom use.

Specs
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 in x 2.25 in x 4.13 in
- Projection: 4.13 in
- Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
- Mounting: Wall mount, concealed screw mounting system
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: False
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to create a coordinated look.
